top_signals.title: Microsoft Teams vishing attacks lead to Chaos ransomware attacks
top_signals.summary: Threat actors are impersonating IT support staff in Microsoft Teams calls to gain remote access to corporate devices and deploy Chaos ransomware in attacks targeting North American organizations. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tokenized gold passes DeFi stress test, but less than 2% is used as collateral
top_signals.summary: A RedStone report found tokenized bullion held up during gold’s sharp sell-off, but DeFi lending adoption remains limited despite surging market growth and trading volumes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
